icons.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated transparent PNG icon for the My Chicken Army skill tree, no surrounding UI. Make an original icon matching the reference visual family.
Image 1 is the project's shipped research feed icon: use it as the primary anchor for heavy black contour, chunky toy-like volume, large clean colored planes, consistent apparent size and crisp upper-left lighting. Image 2 is supporting style evidence only: borrow its saturated glossy cartoon rendering, never its labels, gamepass badges, prices or layout.
Style: sturdy exaggerated forms, a single strong silhouette, continuous thick near-black outer outline, much thinner interior lines, dimensional clean 2.5D cartoon illustration. Broad colored shadows and sparse crisp pale upper-left highlights. Avoid overly low-poly tessellation, photographic rendering, clay emoji, flat pictograms, soft blurry shading or white sticker borders.
Composition: square canvas, complete centered silhouette occupying approximately 80% of the longest dimension, balanced transparent padding. Strong recognition at 64–96 pixels. Genuine alpha transparent background including internal gaps, clean antialiased edges. No ground, scenery, broad drop shadow, rays, sparkles, particles, labels, writing, numbers, prices, multipliers, watermarks, generic badge frame or card. The references are style inputs, not images to ship.
SUBJECT: one broad, sturdy lucky chicken feather, angled gently from lower left to upper right. Vivid emerald-green upper vanes, lime highlights, deeper forest-green lower/right planes, a chunky golden-yellow quill and central shaft with amber shadows. Four or five broad geometric feather segments on each side, no fine hair lines, one or two simple notches. The feather itself is the whole icon; no clover, star or floating luck badge. Slight three-quarter dimensional view, playful rich gloss and thick black contour.
